userStories.name: Publish Vertex control-panel OpenAPI contract
userStories.description: Document the already-live `/api/vertex/v1/admin/control-panel` GET/PUT routes in the canonical and embedded OpenAPI specs, and remove the temporary undocumented-route exception so API Playground and SDK generation can discover the Vertex operator knobs.
bdd_acceptance: Given `pkg/vertex/controlpanel/handler.go` registers GET and PUT `/api/vertex/v1/admin/control-panel`, When the server contract test walks chi routes against `api/openapi.yaml`, Then those routes are not allow-listed as undocumented and are present in the spec.

Given `controlpanel.Config` defines `defaultWindowDays`, `pollingIntervalSec`, `searchAroundMaxNodes`, `searchAroundMaxDepth`, and `missingDataWarningHours`, When the OpenAPI contract is parsed, Then `VertexControlPanelConfig` and the sparse PUT request schema expose the same fields and defaults/operators can inspect the wire shape.
Given the running server serves the embedded OpenAPI copy from `cmd/server/openapi_spec.yaml`, When the embedded-spec drift test runs, Then it remains byte-identical to `api/openapi.yaml`.

userStories.name: Publish Vertex share-link and widget OpenAPI contract
userStories.description: Document the live Vertex share-link and Workshop widget routes so graph sharing and embedded graph consumers are visible to API Playground and future SDK generation instead of remaining in the undocumented-route allow-list.
bdd_acceptance: Given `pkg/vertex/graphsvc/handler.go` registers `/share-links` and `/widget` routes, When the contract test compares chi routes with OpenAPI operations, Then those five routes are present in `api/openapi.yaml` and removed from the undocumented allow-list.

Given share-link recipients get masked graph payloads and widget GET returns a compact payload, When the OpenAPI schema is parsed, Then response/request schemas describe token creation, revocation, masked graph retrieval, widget compact retrieval, and widget save with `overrideGraphRid`.
Given `cmd/server/openapi_spec.yaml` is the runtime served spec, When embedded-spec drift is checked, Then it matches the canonical spec byte-for-byte.

userStories.name: Fix Vertex diagramming deep-link dead end
userStories.description: Ensure `/vertex/{rid}/diagramming` does not dead-end on the SPA wildcard or a stale Coming Soon stub now that Vertex workspace graph rendering, layout, and interactions are live.
bdd_acceptance: Given a user opens `/vertex/{rid}/diagramming`, When the SPA route matches, Then the user lands on a live Vertex graph workspace path or a deliberate redirect to `/vertex/{rid}` rather than `NotFoundPage`.

Given the stale `DiagrammingStubPage` tests still assert `Coming soon`, When the route behavior is updated, Then those assertions are replaced with live workspace/redirect expectations and no user-facing diagramming stub copy remains under `web/src/vertex`.
Given Vertex i18n coverage currently includes diagramming placeholder text, When the placeholder is retired, Then the i18n key parity test remains green without stale `vertex.diagramming.*` keys.
